issues.where: the sea stacks and arches across the background
issues.what: the stacks are chunky, blunt-ended bent cylinders and boxy slabs instead of sleek, tapered, eroded horns, and the lower-right arch is a smooth rounded dome
issues.fix: reshape the stacks into sweeping, pointed, stratified rock spires with weathered ridges and organic jagged silhouettes matching -a

issues.where: the sky and directional lighting on the sea stacks
issues.what: the bright cloud break on the upper right and the warm directional sunlight across the upper faces of the stacks are missing, leaving the stacks flatly lit under uniform dark overcast while an unmatched warm reflection sits on the water
issues.fix: open a bright sunlit break in the upper-right clouds and cast directional warm sunlight across the upper right faces of the sea stacks and tidal flats

issues.where: the upper sky around the sea stacks and the horizon surf
issues.what: the dense flocks of wheeling seabirds are almost completely gone and the white breaking surf along the distant shoreline is missing
issues.fix: add hundreds of distant seabirds wheeling around the spires and restore the line of white ocean surf and mist at the horizon

issues.where: the left cliff face, kelp, and hanging carcass
issues.what: the cliff kelp looks like dry, smooth sculpted brown ridges instead of dark glistening wet seaweed, the dark wet intertidal rock base is missing, and the carcass is too small and tilted
issues.fix: darken and wet the cliff rock and drape it in dense, glossy, tangled dark-olive kelp with a larger hanging carcass naturally embedded in the cliff

issues.where: the wading creatures across the tidal flat
issues.what: the creatures stand in rigid, uniform feeding poses with overly bright, flatly glowing orange wings and no water splashes or taking-off bird on the right
issues.fix: vary the poses including a bird taking off with water spray on the right, dampen the wing translucency to match natural backlighting, and ground their feet in shallow water ripples

issues.where: the foreground tidal flat, gravel, and shallow water
issues.what: the seabed shifts abruptly into a flat, high-contrast tiled carpet of uniform dry grey pebbles and a harsh synthetic bump-map ripple pattern instead of wet silt, fine gravel, seaweed clumps, and shallow flowing water
issues.fix: replace the tiled cobbles and uniform bump ripples with wet muddy sand, varied partially-buried gravel, wet olive seaweed, and smooth braided tidal streams

issues.where: the kelp-covered cliff face on the left
issues.what: the kelp strands look like smooth, matte rubber ribbons with no wet specular sheen, and the clear stream of water pouring down the left edge of the cliff is completely absent
issues.fix: give the kelp thin, wrinkled, glossy wet blades with fine specular highlights and add the dripping water rivulet and spray down the left side

issues.where: the hanging carcass and the cliff behind it
issues.what: the carcass looks dry, chalky, and stone-like with stiff tubular head tendrils instead of wet decaying flesh and delicate filaments, and the additional weathered skeletons further along the cliff are missing
issues.fix: add damp sheen, torn translucent skin, and fine wet tendrils to the carcass, and place the secondary ribcages and bones along the cliff face behind it

issues.where: the background sea stacks, surf, and water
issues.what: the distant sea stacks are blunt hooks and boxy slabs with an unexplained bright white dot at the top edge, no ocean surf, and an overly warm glossy reflection on flat water
issues.fix: match the tapered sunlit sea stacks, bright upper-right cloud break, distant white surf, and natural cool-toned shallow tidepools from -a

issues.where: the foreground creature's feeding tentacles and the water surface
issues.what: the wriggling pink prey is missing and the stiff grey tentacles poke into glassy water with no splashes, dripping water threads, or concentric ripples, while the midground and far-left birds lack head-shake spray and takeoff splashes
issues.fix: add the caught pink prey in the foreground tentacles with active splashes, dripping water, and ripples, plus spray around the midground bird's shaking head and a takeoff splash on the far left

issues.where: the three wading creatures' skin, wings, and anatomy
issues.what: the bodies look dry and chalky with stiff straight necks and thick uniform tentacles, and the wings are uniformly bright orange-peach rather than damp translucent membranes catching rim light
issues.fix: make the skin wetter and more fibrous with hanging droplets on the undersides, taper and soften the tentacles, and shade the wings as thin damp membranes with shadowed folds and warm backlit edges

issues.where: the background sea stacks, horizon surf, and depth of field
issues.what: the background stacks are dark vertical blocky pillars instead of curving tapered spires, the breaking surf is absent, and the image lacks the shallow telephoto depth of field and out-of-focus foreground seaweed of -a
issues.fix: replace the dark pillars with misty curved spires and white shoreline surf, add out-of-focus wet olive seaweed in the bottom-left foreground, and soften focus on the distant background

issues.where: the scavenging crabs and close-up kelp texture
issues.what: the crabs are tiny, crude white stick-legged blobs floating against the smooth blurry kelp ribbons instead of detailed articulated crabs gripping the wet carcass
issues.fix: model detailed wet-shelled crabs with jointed legs perched directly on the carcass spine, and add fine wet specular texture and water beads to the kelp blades

issues.where: the close-up leg skin, wing edge, and tentacle-to-water contact
issues.what: the legs show dry, chalky, carved-looking creases and the rigid grey tentacles enter the bright bumpy water cleanly with no meniscus, droplets, or wet darkening
issues.fix: soften and wet the leg skin texture, darken the wet lower tentacles, and add clinging water droplets, splashes, and surface tension where the tentacles break the water
